AuthorshipTallyCase.description: One case of an argument sitting in a cell's authorship tally.

argued.description: The day the case was argued
argued.title: Argued

author.description: The lead opinion's author (the opinion of the Court or a plurality), as the roster spells the Justice; null while undecided, for a decision no opinion names an author for (a per curiam, a dismissal), and for one the per-opinion record does not hold (`recorded` false)
author.title: Author

decided.description: The day the case was decided, on or before the tally's `as_of`; null while undecided as of that day
decided.title: Decided

docket.description: The docket number as the record prints it
docket.title: Docket

key.description: The corpus case id, or `docket:<number>` where the per-opinion record links the opinion to no corpus row
key.title: Key

recorded.description: Whether the per-opinion record holds the case's lead opinion; a decided case it does not hold has an unknown author, not a missing one
recorded.title: Recorded

AuthorshipTallySitting.description: One argument sitting of a cell's authorship tally.

bench.description: The Justices serving on the sitting's first day, oldest oath first
bench.title: Bench

cases.description: The sitting's cases, by argument day then key
cases.title: Cases

end.description: The sitting's last day, as the Court heads it
end.title: End

start.description: The sitting's first day, as the Court heads it
start.title: Start

yet_to_write.description: The bench's Justices with no lead opinion recorded for the sitting as of the tally's day, oldest oath first
yet_to_write.title: Yet To Write

AuthorshipTallySitting.title: AuthorshipTallySitting

description:
Who has written from each argument sitting of a Term, as of one day.

Written by ``fedcourts authorship-tally`` and, for a post-argument merits
predict cell in forward mode once released (``provision.AUTHORSHIP_TALLY_WITHHELD``),
into its ``record/authorship-tally.json`` (``pipeline.authorship``): the tally
as of the day before the cell's cutoff, so the cell reads no decision its
moment postdates.

as_of.description: The last day whose decisions are read, inclusive
as_of.title: As Of

sittings.description: The Term's sittings that opened by `as_of`, earliest first; empty where the corpus stores none
sittings.title: Sittings

title: AuthorshipTally
